verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions product telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out switch. Self-hosting and data-sovereignty claims are adjacent features, not a documented telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
